authority: Own original planning envelope and board note only; no product/test/build/package/install/process-termination action executed.
intent: Bind Windows native acceptance to the actual reviewed artifact and module revisions; make blocked prerequisites visible instead of substituting historical builds or unit tests.
observations: package.json build script is tauri build; running it would be a real build/package action, not a harmless UI syntax check. Not run.
Current Tauri config declares EluSlot/0.1.0, frontendDist ../ui and bundle.targets=all. This static declaration does not prove portable or installer readiness.
Portable README describes a 2026-10-25 artifact. Its documented hash is historical, not proof of a current Phase1 build. No old binary launched or repackaged.
WiX verify-install checklist explicitly distinguishes contract green from elevated native install. No elevated install evidence borrowed for portable acceptance.
M02-S1 acceptance is CHANGES_REQUIRED for F1/F2 with valid RED; no product generator exists. This is a module prerequisite status, not a reason to block M08 evidence-plan preparation.

evidence_layers.E0: Approved spec/contracts and source inspection only
evidence_layers.E1: Compiled tests plus actual RED/GREEN logs with invocation/exit code
evidence_layers.E3: Locked release artifact running in native UI environment
evidence_layers.rule: Higher-layer claims cannot be inferred from a lower layer. NOT RUN or BLOCKED remains explicit; evidence field presence is not behavior PASS.

consistency: Executable path and bytes must match the artifact that ran, not a similarly named historical copy.
Record exact dirty source inventory used by the build: HEAD alone is insufficient.
Screenshots must be tied to same run/process identity; source captures are not native UI proof.
Missing runtime/capability marks BLOCKED_NOT_RUN; test assertion mismatch after prerequisites satisfied marks FAIL.
Evidence aggregation is read-only; M08 cannot change another module contract or status to obtain PASS.

architecture.hexagonal_view: Native operator/test driver -> declared UI/input boundaries -> module application/domain -> ports <- real Windows adapters. M08 observes outcomes and evidence; it does not bypass application safety.
architecture.dependency_view: M01 identity + M03 UI + M04 history + M05 material + M06 import + M07 recovery -> M08 bounded integration cases -> human review. M02 generated skeleton validation is separately gated, not implied by existing shell launch.
architecture.ownership: Product state stays with owning modules; fixture sandbox and evidence belong to the run. M08 health projection is not a new product SSOT.
architecture.mutation_boundary: Future operator acts only through authorized product operations on disposable inputs; direct test corruption is isolated fault injection. No real project/recovery deletion.
architecture.transaction_boundary: Artifact lock and fixture preparation -> run -> verify hashes/observable result -> preserve evidence -> cleanup only known disposable paths. Failure preserves diagnostic evidence and never changes external user data.
